Felt they had 2 tiered pricing
Feb 2020
The food was good, had steamed large prawns, deep fried squid, a dish called beef with onion which was delicious but not what we had expected and fried rice which was very garlicky. We also had 4 Larue beers between the 3 of us. The bill came up to 670,000 vnd which is an expensive meal for Vietnamese local fare? There were a couple of non Vietnamese eating there as well but the majority looked like locals, with many large tables of 6-10 people. Knowing how much Vietnamese earn in their own country, I would bet they are charged a different price for their fresh seafood.
It’s an open air restaurant where locals think nothing of spitting their bones and shrimp shells onto the floor as one dude across from us did throughout our meal.

Excellent sea food in a local place
Sep 2018 • Couples
We went there at about 17.30. There were a few Vietnamese customers. However about 45min later the place was full. Even as being the only caucasian I can say the food is great. We ordered prawns, snail, oysters, vegetable, fried rice and 3 beers for less than 500K! 
The prawns were super fresh and yummie BBQ’ed. The beers were 15K!! The egg fried rice was really very tasty. The oysters I left for my girlfriend but she enjoyed them very mush as also the snails. I tasted them as well and also very fresh. 
It is a wonderful local place where yiu can enjoy the atmosphere of local Vietnamese ambience and noise. The motorcycles are making yiu sure you know you are in Asia. I prefer to sit on the small chairs and tables outside.
Do not be afraid and just try this place!
